title: No Ominous Banners
description: Pillager Captains no longer drop their banners upon death. This ensures unclogged farms and boots performance
body:
# 🧭 Introduction

**This is a lightweight server-side optimization mod designed for Minecraft servers that frequently run raids or pillager-related farms. It focuses on improving farm efficiency and reducing unnecessary item clutter without changing core gameplay mechanics.
**
# ⚙️ What This Mod Does

** The mod prevents Pillager Captains from dropping Ominous Banners when they are defeated. By removing this drop, it stops banner items from accumulating during large-scale raid farms or patrol grinding setups.**

# 🚀 Performance Benefits

** By eliminating constant banner item drops, the mod reduces entity load and item lag in high-activity areas. This helps improve overall server stability, especially on survival SMPs or automated farming servers where raids are repeatedly triggered for Ominous Bottles and loot farming.**

# 🔧 Compatibility

** Fully server-side and does not require clients to install anything. Works seamlessly with vanilla mechanics and most fabric-based server environments.
**

A simple but effective optimization for smoother raid farming and cleaner servers ✨
